purpose: Self-contained examples for humans, code search, documentation tooling, and AI/LLM indexing.

conventions.imports: Examples import from ../../src/index.js so repository type-checking validates public exports.
conventions.network: network=true examples call external public APIs and can be rate-limited.
conventions.units: SI units are used unless the symbol or comment explicitly states otherwise.
conventions.safety: Engineering examples are educational/architectural and are not flight-qualified analyses.
